create_TextNetConfig: create a TextNetConfig instance with default or custom model hyperparameters
initialize_TextNetConfig_defaults: initialize TextNetConfig with default stem kernel size, stride, and channel settings
configure_TextNet_conv_layers: configure TextNetConfig with custom conv_layer_kernel_sizes and conv_layer_strides for each stage
set_TextNet_output_features: set TextNetConfig output features and output indices for multi-scale feature extraction
build_TextNetBackbone_config: build a TextNetBackbone model using a configured TextNetConfig instance
